title: After the Holidays Chicken Cordon Bleu Casserole
description: Leftover holiday ham joins chicken and Swiss cheese in this easy cordon bleu casserole that delivers fancy flavor in a comfort food dish that's super simple to throw together.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil, or as needed
1 pound cubed boneless, skinless chicken breast
0.125 teaspoon paprika, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
1 (10.5 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (10.5 ounce) can cream of broccoli soup

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Heat a large frying pan over medium heat. Coat the hot pan with olive oil; add chicken and cook until browned on all sides, 5 to 7 minutes. Season with paprika, salt, and pepper. Add onion and garlic; cook until softened, about 5 minutes. Add ham and cook for 2 more minutes.

Mix condensed soups, sour cream, 1/2 cup Swiss cheese, and chicken broth together in a separate bowl. Add to the chicken mixture and stir until well combined. Transfer to a large casserole dish and top with remaining Swiss cheese.
Cook in the preheated oven until casserole is cooked through and cheese is melted, 20 to 25 minutes.
